dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge forming a falcate spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a low pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Posteriorly inclined anterior margin at approximately 50 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height ratio of approximately 1.5:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Structural convexity with a defined arc radius along the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak extending from the melon inflection point with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular and irregular light-colored spots/blotches visible on the mid-lateral and anterior-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Global cyan luminescence and low-polygon geometric facets visible along the silhouette edges.
